銃.meaning: A rich pirate refuses to use cannonballs. He has his blacksmith <part>fill</part> a long brass tube with <part>gold</part> coins, aims it at a rival ship and fires a glittering shower of treasure. The rival crew drops their swords to pick it up. It's the friendliest <kanji>gun</kanji> at sea.
銃.on: One of the coins is a big <sound>jew</sound>el, which knocks off the rival captain's hat.
銃.kun: The smoke makes the pirate sneeze, '<sound>Tsu</sound>! <sound>Tsu</sound>!', as he peers down the barrel: a tube.

虚.meaning: A <part>tiger</part> floats out of his spaceship carrying a stand of <part>candles</part>, hoping to find a cosy corner of space. He strikes match after match, but nothing lights, nothing echoes, nothing is there at all. Just the endless black <kanji>void</kanji>.
虚.on: Far off, a tiny <sound>kio</sound>sk drifts by, shutters down.
虚.kun: A lonely <sound>moo</sound>se floats past, licking the last crumb of <sound>na</sound>an from an empty plate.

劣.meaning: At the beach weightlifting contest, the champion crab flexes a thousand ripples, while little Gary can show only a <part>few</part> specks of <part>muscle</part>. He lifts a single grain of sand, sighs, and hides in his shell with a deep feeling of <kanji>inferiority</kanji>.
劣.on: That night he sips a thimble of <sound>rets</sound>ina and tells the moon about it.
劣.kun: '<sound>Oh</sound> well,' he mumbles, and climbs a driftwood <sound>to</sound>tem pole to feel a bit taller.

巨.meaning: You open your bedside <part>drawer</part> to grab a sock and keep pulling. It slides out across the bedroom, through the wall and halfway down the street, with a whale snoring inside next to your socks. This drawer is <kanji>gigantic</kanji>.
巨.on: Further in, past the whale, there's a whole newspaper <sound>kio</sound>sk selling maps of the drawer.

偽.meaning: A con man keeps a disguise on every <part>coat hook</part> in his hall: a pilot's cap, a doctor's coat, a duchess's tiara. Each morning he picks one and writes his list of things to <part>do</part>: fly a plane, cure a cold, open a ball. Every line on it is a <kanji>falsehood</kanji>.
偽.on: Even his fancy watch is fake: every <sound>gear</sound> inside is painted on.
偽.kun: When he's caught, he squeaks '<sound>Ee</sound>!', fakes a sneeze, '<sound>Tsu</sound>!', and wails '<sound>Wah</sound>!' as if he were the victim.

崩.meaning: One night the <part>twin moons</part> hang too low and rest their chins on top of a <part>mountain</part> to gaze at the sea. They're heavier than they look: the peak creaks, cracks and slides away in a roaring river of pebbles. Even mountains <kanji>crumble</kanji>.
崩.on: Rangers spray down the dust with a long garden <sound>ho</sound>se.
崩.kun: A <sound>cu</sound>ckoo flees the rubble, clutching a yu<sound>zu</sound> in its beak.

壊.meaning: A giant wants a bigger house, so he gets rid of his old empty hut his own way: he heaps <part>soil</part> on it, throws a <part>net</part> over the top, stuffs an old <part>garment</part> down the chimney, counts to <part>ten</part> and stomps. Splinters fly everywhere. A one-giant <kanji>demolition</kanji>.
壊.on: The roof sails off into the sky like a <sound>ki</sound>te.
壊.kun: A <sound>ko</sound>ala napping in the rafters lands in the rubble and wails '<sound>Wah</sound>!'
